title: The Library of Almosts
synopsis: Luna helps you keep an unfinished idea without shame. Dreamlight is her essence — never a separate creature.

nodes.speaker: luna
nodes.body:
The library of almosts glows soft violet. Unfinished pages float like sleepy moths.

Luna's Dreamlight — her essence — sketches a ribbon path. "Almosts are not failures. They are invitations."

choices.label: Ask Nori what is quiet here
Invite Moki for a kind plot twist

nodes.speaker: luna
nodes.body:
You choose a half-written story. Dreamlight warm, not bright-pressure.

"We can finish one sentence together. Or leave it open. Both are brave."

nodes.speaker: nori
nodes.body:
Nori lifts Lowbeam. Tidelight (essence) makes a soft crescent.

"The quiet is not empty. It is waiting room for ideas."

choices.label: Thank Nori and return to Luna

nodes.speaker: moki
nodes.body:
Moki's Sparklight flickers like pixels that mean well.

"Plot twist: the almost becomes a beginning. No shame, only sparkles."

choices.label: Laugh softly and pick a page

nodes.speaker: luna
nodes.body:
Dreamlight settles like a bookmark of light.

"Your Heartlight care for me is not feeding a pet-soul. It is friendship practice.

Little lights. Big little almosts that still count."
nodes.memory: Visited Luna's Library of Almosts — unfinished ideas are welcome.
